description: This file defines extensions on the ProcessInfo class to determine runtime environment states, such as whether the app is running in preview mode, in nix mode, or during tests. It also includes a static method to resolve nix mode based on environment variables and UserDefaults settings.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Existing class extended with additional computed properties and methods for environment detection.

methods.name: isPreview
methods.description: Checks if the app is running for Xcode previews by inspecting an environment variable.

methods.name: resolveNixMode
methods.description: Determines whether nix mode should be enabled based on environment variables and UserDefaults. It differentiates behavior based on whether the app is bundled.

methods.name: isNixMode
methods.description: Computed property that checks whether nix mode is active, by calling resolveNixMode with current environment and UserDefaults.

methods.name: isRunningTests
methods.description: Checks if the app is running unit tests by inspecting loaded bundles and environment variables related to XCTest.
